name: Jonespyre's Request
objectiveText: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

comments.body: Is there a trick to getting this quest? I'm level 48, exalted with Darnassus, and cannot get this one nor the one from Tannysa, nor does Quintis offer his quest...
replies: Ok the prereq for this quest is to do [url=http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?source=live;wquest=3764]Un'Goro Soil[/url] first; then Tannysa or Shyria will offer the quest to talk to Quintis.

comments.body: Becomes available once [quest=3785 domain=classic] is completed.
replies: Cannot be the complete truth. Morrowgrain Research is completed but this quest is still not available.

comments.body: Well, the description of this 30 second quest segment seems wrong to me.  I picked this up from the Innkeeper (Shyria) right in Feathermoon.
This all seems right, I picked it up from 	Tannysa in Stormwind.
